posts.author: CorgiCabal
posts.body:
Hello,
First post. This is more of an onboarding note (so it's Site Feedback). I have experience with other engines and wanted to check out RPG Maker ecosystem and the first thing that stands out is the number of acronyms. There's a lot! I'm not even sure where to click.
I sort of expected versions. Versions also make the self-study pathway a bit more obvious -- just go for the latest as a new user.
So the site feedback: some kind of acronym guide or tooltips might reduce "overwhelm" a bit.
Also any pointers with where to start would be appreciated. Thanks!
